final: WITH t AS (SELECT p.birth_country AS c, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), s AS (SELECT c, tally, tally * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(tally) FROM t) AS share, (SELECT AVG(tally) FROM t) AS avg_tally FROM t) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(tally - avg_tally) AS avg_excess_over_avg FROM s WHERE tally > avg_tally
